description: 2,500 real handwritten MNIST digits (250 per class), skeletonised to 1-px centre lines (scikit-image) and stored as (x,y) byte pairs on the 28x28 grid. Used to benchmark the stroke rasteriser + model on real human handwriting shapes.
source: MNIST database (Yann LeCun, Corinna Cortes, Christopher J.C. Burges) via the 'mnist' npm package (MIT). MNIST is available under CC BY-SA 3.0.
